image_description: A close-up, front-facing view of a white audio cassette tape. The image shows the two circular spools with visible magnetic tape wound around them, separated by black plastic internal structures. A rectangular label area in the lower center contains handwritten orange text. There are molded details including screw holes and write-protect tabs on the bottom corners. The top edge shows some faint, illegible printed text.

artifact_observations.location: Top edge of the cassette casing
artifact_observations.reasoning: The printed text at the very top is blurry and illegible, resembling AI-generated pseudo-text rather than crisp manufacturing marks.
The orange handwriting has a slightly 'smudged' or painted look rather than sharp ink on paper, though it is legible enough to pass as stylized writing.
The teeth on the white spools are slightly irregular and lack the precise mechanical uniformity expected of molded plastic parts, appearing somewhat soft.

To analyze the legibility and structure of the handwritten label and the gibberish text at the top.

To assess the sharpness of molded details and detect any subtle blending artifacts.

focus_areas: Legibility and realism of the handwritten label text
Structural integrity and symmetry of the tape spools
Clarity of molded plastic details (screw holes, tabs)
Authenticity of the top-edge printed text
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'text_gibberish' artifact at the top. While the main label is handwritten, the printed manufacturing text should be crisp. If the top text is nonsensical, it is a strong indicator of AI generation. Also, verify if the spool teeth are mechanically plausible or if they show signs of melting/irregularity.
